d:
Listen to the evergreen "Ninnegintha Indhu Chenna" Audio Song from the classic Kannada movie "Apoorva Sangama", featuring Dr. Rajkumar, Shankar Nag and Ambika.
The song is sung by legendary playback singer Vani Jairam, with music composed by Upendra Kumar and lyrics penned by Chi. Udayashankar. The film was directed by Y. R. Swamy.
Directed by: Y. R. Swamy
Produced by: Y. R. Swamy, Naveen Kumar
Written by: K.A. Narayan
Starring: Dr. Rajkumar, Shankar Nag, Ambika, T. N. Balakrishna, Thoogudeepa Srinivas
Music Director: Upendra Kumar
Cinematography: B. C. Gowrishankar
